content.title: About
content.content: Jelly roll cake is a light sponge roll filled with fruit jelly and often topped with a glaze. The batter is made from eggs, sugar, flour, and a small amount of leavening, baked as a thin sheet, spread with jelly, and rolled into a cylindrical shape.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The jelly roll originated in the United States in the early 20th century and quickly became a party favorite.
Traditional fillings use berry jelly, but variations with cream, fruit puree, or chocolate are common.
The name comes from the English word “roll,” not from “jellybean.”
In some countries the dessert is called a “Swiss roll” or “biscuit roll.”
The thin sponge layer helps the roll keep its shape even after slicing.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The thin sponge contains little fat, especially when minimal butter or oil is used in the batter.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Eggs and whole‑grain flour provide riboflavin (B2), pyridoxine (B6) and folate.

items.title: Fruit jelly
items.content: Berry jelly adds vitamin C and antioxidants.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The cake is light and can serve as a quick post‑workout snack.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Both the jelly and the sponge often contain high amounts of sugar, which may be problematic for people with diabetes.

items.title: Egg and gluten allergy
items.content: Traditional recipes use eggs and wheat flour, making the cake unsuitable for those with related allergies.

items.title: Acidity of jelly
items.content: Sour jelly can irritate a sensitive stomach in some individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the jelly roll chilled, sliced into portions. It can be garnished with fresh berries, whipped cream, or a dusting of powdered sugar. Pairs well with tea or a light dessert wine.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the cake refrigerated, wrapped in plastic film or stored in an airtight container, for up to 3–4 days. For longer storage, freeze the sliced portions.
